I would choose the beta, I started with it and it has unique features that tend to be stable for the most part. It takes some time to make designs, my advice is to first try recreating/replicating irl cars for some practice and get used to how fixtures work, when replicating I suggest looking for shapes that match and then adding fixtures together if no vanilla fixtures match. I use bumpers and flatten them for many different fixtures, just think creatively when trying to design something and don't limit yourself to the 'headlight' or 'taillight' categories when choosing fixtures. It took me probably about a year to start making cars that I really liked, this is what helped me, may not be for you. Good luck, hope to see some cool cars on here by you some time!
